TASHKENTSPIRE2-MARK.title: Mark
TASHKENTSPIRE2-MARK.description: When taking Attack damage, increase that damage by the number of [gold]Mark[/gold] stacks, then lose [blue]1[/blue] stack.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-TORPEDO.title: Torpedo
TASHKENTSPIRE2-CHARGE.title: Charge
TASHKENTSPIRE2-CHARGE.description:
Increase your [gold]Distance[/gold], normally up to [blue]5[/blue].
Each point of Distance gained increases Attack damage dealt by [gold]20%[/gold] and Attack damage taken by [gold]10%[/gold].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-RETREAT.title: Retreat
TASHKENTSPIRE2-RETREAT.description:
Decrease your [gold]Distance[/gold], down to [blue]-5[/blue].
Each point of Distance lost decreases Attack damage dealt by [gold]20%[/gold] and Attack damage taken by [gold]10%[/gold].
TASHKENTSPIRE2-AMMU.title: Ammo
TASHKENTSPIRE2-AMMU.description:
Current Ammo / Maximum Ammo.
During combat, each Ammo spent triggers the effect after [gold]Fire[/gold].
Ammo is retained between combats.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-AMMU-MAX.title: Maximum Ammo
TASHKENTSPIRE2-AMMU-MAX.description: The maximum amount of Ammo this card can hold.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-LOAD.title: Load
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SHOT.title: Focus Fire X
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SHOT.description: When played, if the chosen amount of [gold]Ammo[/gold] is greater than or equal to X, trigger the additional effect.
